report.title: fix(firestore): validate session identity components before path use
report.summary: This pull request adds validation for session identity components before path construction in the Firestore session service along with unit tests. Static analysis identified minor code style suggestions from linter diagnostics, but no correctness or security defects were found in the changed code.

verified_comments.finding: Ruff diagnostic UP045 suggests using `X | None` instead of `Optional[X]`. While using `X | None` is modern Python style, `Optional` remains functionally correct.
verified_comments.recommendation: Optionally update the type annotation to `X | None` for consistency with PEP 604.

verified_comments.finding: Ruff diagnostic SIM117 flags nested `with` statements. Combining context managers into a single `with` statement is cleaner, though nested blocks are functionally identical.
verified_comments.recommendation: Optionally combine the nested `with` statements into a single `with A, B:` statement.

tool_evidence.message: Use a single `with` statement with multiple contexts instead of nested `with` statements
